profile.headline: Software systems architect
profile.summary:
Front to back design and development of high throughput applications including an email threat detection and quarantine system, geospatial search engine, draggable routes, back end route services, industrial camera sequencing and inspection, public safety systems. Primarily worked with Java and C++, deploying in multiple cloud infrastructures.

Specialties: high-performance back end systems, concurrency, front-to-back architecture

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: Designed and implemented a system that automatically recognizes and quarantines company email threats. Collaborated with multiple teams to ensure other Cofense products worked seamlessly with this system. Used by companies from a few hundred employees to a few hundred thousand employees. Worked directly with large clients to ensure scalability and resolve issues. Deployed in AWS, Azure, on-prem, and hosted SaaS.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Implemented inventory tracking software for the Navy. Spring Boot / thymeleaf.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Work with a small geographically distributed team to design and develop distributed erasure coding capabilities for the existing exascale fault-tolerant object storage product (WOS). Implement client and server side operations including rebuild for failure conditions.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Implement Java backend for Nielsen web applications. Work with multiple teams to ensure that services are production-ready. Configure and architect for scalability and throughput. Diagnose infrastructure and service interconnect issues and identify solutions. Revamped build and deploy process to streamline flow and implement industry best practices. Verification of deployment environment correctness through test suites that query the live services. Design and implement GIS services including geocoding and routing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
MapQuest Search, Core Services
Design and development of new back end geospatial search platform used by MapQuest website and mobile applications; Third party data feed integration
Front-to-back design and development of draggable routes, time dependent routing, and search-along-route.
Automated testing, performance optimization. Upgraded 32 bit C++ code to 64 bit platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
high-performance industrial software to sequence and inspect images from multiple cameras
integration of 1394-DCAM cameras from multiple vendors into the system;

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Design / implementation of GIS web applications using GeoMedia WebMap, ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, VB, Java, Oracle, and XML.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of GUI used in a 24x7x365 public-safety radio dispatching environment
Development of system configuration software, low level communication protocols, relational databases
Worked with embedded software group on system design and protocols that affect PC products
Taught department-wide C++/OOD class; modified assembly language firmware to accommodate new front-end software capabilities.

patents.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR GENERATING ELECTRONIC MAP DISPLAYS WITH POINTS-OF-INTEREST BASED ON DENSITY THRESHOLDS
patents.description: Methods and systems are provided for generating an electronic map display. In one implementation, a method is provided for determining a route distance based on information for a route, comparing the route distance with a distance threshold, defining a search area when the route distance is less than the distance threshold, the search area including boundaries, calculating, using a processor, a points of interest (POI) density of the search area, comparing the POI density with a first density threshold and a second density threshold, adjusting the boundaries of the search area based on a result of comparing the POI density with the first density threshold and the second density threshold, identifying POIs in the adjusted search area, and providing POI information for an electronic map display, the POI information being associated with one or more POIs identified in the adjusted search area.

patents.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR GENERATING ELECTRONIC MAP DISPLAYS WITH POINTS-OF-INTEREST INFORMATION BASED ON REFERENCE LOCATIONS
patents.description: Methods and systems are provided for generating an electronic map display. In one implementation, a method is provided for receiving route information associated with a route having an origination point and a destination point, determining a location of a reference point along the route, assigning a spatial identifier to the reference point, searching for points of interest (POIs) in a search area associated with the spatial identifier, ranking, using a processor, the POIs based on distances of POIs from the location of the reference point, and providing POI information for an electronic map display, wherein the POI information is associated with one or more POIs and selected based on the ranking of the POIs.
